title: Polarization decreases coalitional influence
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $i$ be a coordinate. Form the polarization of $f$ at $i$ by assigning, at each input, the maximum of the two values obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $1$ or $-1$ when that input has coordinate $i=1$, and the minimum of those values when it has coordinate $i=-1$. The coalitional influence of this polarized function on $J$ is at most that of $f$ on $J$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
